name: Sun
description: The central yellow dwarf star that holds 99.86% of the solar system's mass.
notableMissions: Parker Solar Probe, SOHO, Solar Orbiter

name: Mercury
description: The smallest, crater-covered innermost planet with virtually no atmosphere.

name: Venus
description: Earth's toxic twin, swathed in sulfuric acid clouds with a runaway greenhouse furnace.

name: Earth
description: Our home planet, the only known cradle of life with liquid water oceans and a protective magnetosphere.
notableMissions: Thousands of Earth-observing satellites; departure point for all deep-space missions.

name: Mars
description: The Red Planet: a frozen desert world of ancient river deltas, colossal volcanoes, and human robotic artifacts.
notableMissions: Mariner, Viking, Pathfinder, MER Spirit/Opportunity, MSL Curiosity, Mars 2020 Perseverance.

name: Jupiter
description: The gargantuan king of planets with a swirling Great Red Spot and over 95 moons.
notableMissions: Pioneer 10/11, Voyager 1/2, Galileo, Juno, Europa Clipper

name: Saturn
description: Famous for its dazzling system of ice rings and intriguing ocean moons Enceladus and Titan.

name: Uranus
description: An icy cyan giant tilted on its side, rolling around the Sun like a ball.

name: Neptune
description: The farthest major planet, whipped by supersonic methane winds over 2,000 km/h.
